Shri S.S.Bansal - Advocate for the respondents
 Order
Heard the counsels of the parties and perused the record.

2 . This Miscellanous Appeal has been preferred by the appellant/claimant challenging the award dated 28.11.2008 passed by the Third Additional MACT, Shivpuri , whereby MACT has dismissed the claim of the appellant/claimant.
3.

The facts necessary for the disposal of the case are that on 18.09.2007 at 11 P.M., the appellant Deepak Goyal along with his friend Manish was going on his motorcycle from Satanbada to Shivpuri, as soon as he reached Satanbada hospital, M.B road chauraha, at that time, in centre of the road, Truck No.R.J.11G.A.0147 was standing and there was no light or any indication that it was standing.
Due to which the claimant dashed the truck, as a result of which, he got grievous injuries.

4. It reveals that the claimant/appellant has failed to prove the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-GWL:14153 2 MA-311-2009 permanent disability in this case, as no certificate of permanent disability was adduced on behalf of the claimant, nor any medical officer who assessed the permanent disability has been examined.
The provision of Section 163- A of the Motor Vehicle Act is applicable in the case and compensation amount has to be calculated as per Second Schedule.
The compensation may be granted under this provision for third party for fatal accident/injuries and permanent disability.

The provision of Section 163-A of the said Act also mandates that in case of "death or permanent disablement" due to the injuries arising out of the accident, compensation may be granted under this provision.

5. Since it is not a case of death or permanent disability, therefore, the appeal filed on behalf of the claimant is not maintainable; it is hereby dismissed.
